full_prompt_en: A square staged fashion photograph shows five women standing in a straight, quiet row before a tall, glowing window in a rose colored room. The central woman stands slightly forward, wearing a deep burgundy long sleeved blouse and a high waisted cream pleated skirt. A pale headband separates her dark hair from the luminous curtains behind, and her hands rest gently together at waist height. Four women flank her, two on each side, in long dusty pink dresses with fitted bodices and full skirts. Their pale hair and faces are partly subdued by the backlight, so the central dark blouse becomes the strongest visual anchor. The window extends almost from the ceiling to the floor and is covered by gathered white sheer drapery, its vertical folds spilling light down the middle of the frame. Narrow reddish walls border that bright center. At both lower corners, small tables with white lace cloths hold rounded arrangements of muted pink flowers. On the right a low upholstered seat enters the composition beneath the table; on the left another floral cluster balances it. The floor remains mostly dark and the group appears still, with symmetrical spacing and restrained expressions. Soft frontal fill keeps the garments visible while the window glows behind them, leaving gentle shadow in the corners and along the lower hems. The photograph combines formal balance, muted warmth, and an almost dreamlike haze, without losing the fabric texture of the skirts or the quiet detail of the room.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形摆拍时装摄影作品展现五位女子在玫瑰色房间里，面对一扇高大明亮的窗户静静排成一列。中央女子稍稍站在前方，身穿深酒红色长袖上衣和高腰奶油白百褶长裙。浅色发带将她的深发与身后发光的窗帘分开，双手轻轻合拢在腰前。其余四位女子每侧两人，穿着灰粉色长裙，收腰上身连接宽阔裙摆。她们的浅色头发与脸被逆光稍稍压低，因此中央深色上衣成为最强的视觉锚点。窗户几乎从天花板延伸到地面，覆着聚拢的白色薄纱帘，竖向褶皱把光倾入画面中央。狭窄的红褐色墙面夹住明亮中心。两个下角各有铺白色蕾丝桌布的小桌，上面放着圆团状的低饱和粉花。右侧桌下露出一张低矮软垫座椅，左侧另一团花与之平衡。地面大多深暗，人物保持静止，间距对称、神情克制。柔和正面补光让衣服仍可见，而后方窗户发亮，角落与裙摆下缘留下轻柔阴影。照片把正式的平衡、低饱和暖色与近乎梦境的薄雾结合，同时保留裙装的布料肌理和房间安静的细节。
style_prompt_en: Staged color photography uses formal symmetry, close tonal relationships, and luminous backlight to create a subdued, theatrical atmosphere. A bright vertical center is framed by darker warm planes, while repeated upright forms establish an even rhythm across the middle distance. The palette holds dusty rose, muted mauve, cream, deep wine red, and soft taupe within a narrow range of saturation. Translucent layers diffuse the strongest light into long pale streaks; low intensity frontal fill preserves surface texture against the glow. Edges are gently softened by a light veil of haze, though selected folds and trim retain enough clarity to make the image tangible. Paired accents near the lower corners counterweight the central mass, and shadow deepens toward the outer edges and bottom. Smooth tonal transitions, quiet negative space, and a restrained contrast keep the arrangement poised. The resulting image feels intimate yet ceremonious, with a subtle tension between strict order and atmospheric softness.
style_prompt_zh: 摆拍彩色摄影以正式对称、接近的色调关系和明亮逆光营造低调的戏剧气氛。明亮竖向中心被较暗的暖色平面包围，中景重复的直立形体形成均匀节奏。灰粉、低饱和淡紫、奶油白、深酒红与柔和灰褐保持在狭窄的饱和度范围内。半透明层把最强的光散成修长浅色光带，低强度正面补光则在辉光前保留表面纹理。轻微薄雾柔化边缘，但若干褶皱与边饰仍清楚到足以使画面可触。下方两角成对的重音平衡中央体量，阴影向外缘和底部加深。平滑色调过渡、安静留白和克制对比让安排保持端正。最终影像既亲密又带仪式感，严格秩序与柔软空气感之间维持微妙张力。
theme_en: Five women standing together in a softly lit rose colored room
theme_zh: 五位女子并立在柔光笼罩的玫瑰色房间中
name: Cristina Coral
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
